entities.summary: Television Hokkaido Broadcasting Co., Ltd. , callsigns JOHI-DTV is a Japanese television station based in Sapporo serving as the affiliate of the TX Network for Hokkaido. TVh started broadcasting in 1989. Nikkei, Inc. is the biggest shareholder of TVh. Television Hokkaido is a television station in Sapporo, established in 1989. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
